name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois’s journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father’s small garage in rural France. He developed a keen eye for detail and a relentless drive for precision, quickly becoming known for his exceptional fabrication skills. After completing his apprenticeship, Jean-Pierre honed his craft working for a local racing team, where he specialized in chassis and suspension components.

His approach to fabrication is methodical and meticulous. He believes that the smallest imperfection can compromise performance. Jean-Pierre's loyalty to Oregon Team is unwavering, and his dedication to his work is unmatched. He is a perfectionist, always striving for the highest standards, and his years of experience make him an invaluable asset to the team, particularly when facing complex challenges or tight deadlines. Jean-Pierre's innovative solutions during the 2022 season greatly contributed to Oregon Team's podium success.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a sturdy build and kind eyes.
